title: spec: the knowledge-source-id-to-name conversion says "no index is rebuilt" without the leading-underscore exception
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #38050 (#38022; L1 ACCEPT 7236095767, which names it worth a card) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Bug · p3 (suggested: an upgrade notice that is true for every source but one class; the tombstone and upgrade entry already teach the exception) · reach: an author upgrading from 18 whose `knowledgeSources[].id` starts with an underscore, reading `os migrate meta --from 18` · evidence: read on origin/main e3bdc74884: `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/19/knowledge-source-id-to-name.ts` `summary` reads "the value is unchanged, so no index is rebuilt", and its jsdoc says "the rename starts no rebuild (K6 item 4)". PR #38050 teaches, on the `id` tombstone and in entry `19.knowledge-source-registration-governed`'s `reason`, that `name` refuses a leading underscore, so such a source takes a new name, is built again under it, and must drop its old index with `dropSource`.
Dedupe: `is:issue knowledge-source-id-to-name underscore rebuilt` → checked at filing; open: #38022 (the parent) only.
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：从 18 升级时，迁移工具对"知识源 id 改名为 name"的说明写着"值不变，所以不重建索引"。但 id 以下划线开头的知识源不能直接沿用(name 不允许下划线开头)，要换新名字并重建索引。这一类没被说到。
- 做什么：在迁移工具的那句说明里补上这个例外，与 PR #38050 已改的说明保持一致。
- 谁受益：从 18 升级、知识源 id 以下划线开头的作者(照提示做不会漏掉重建和清理旧索引)。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
In `knowledge-source-id-to-name.ts`, qualify `summary` and the jsdoc's "the rename starts no rebuild" with the exception PR #38050 states. A source whose id starts with an underscore cannot keep it as `name`. It takes a new name and is built again under it, and its old index is dropped with `dropSource`, which the author runs: it is not automatic. Check what `renameKey` does with such a value today (rewrite it to a `name` the parse then refuses, or refuse it), and make the summary match.

## Acceptance
- `os migrate meta --from 18` on a fixture with an underscore-led id prints a notice that names the exception and the remedy. A fixture with a plain id still reads "no index is rebuilt".
- The conversion's fixture or a test pins the underscore case.
- The wording agrees with the `id` tombstone and entry `19.knowledge-source-registration-governed` as landed by PR #38050.

Blocked-by: #38050
